maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's canary fallout. We got lucky with the fallback but we need durable fixes for rollout safety: automated rollback triggers, stricter default percents, and deployment-time gates.

maya: TL;DR: flag rolled to 8% w/o rollback enabled. monitoring alerted but there was no automatic flip. Ops had to manually revert. Need to remove this manual step.

rick: I'll take ownership of the rollback automation end-to-end. Plan: controller listens to alert events and evaluates configured rollback rules. Aim to have a thin POC by end of week.

ortega: I'll handle the default-percentage policy and approval matrix. Proposal: new flags start at 0.5% unless labeled "infra:" then 5%. Also add per-service caps so a single flag can't exceed X% of user-base for sensitive services. Drafting RFC.

nina: I'll add a deploy-time validation to CI so any non-zero rollout must either have auto_rollback=true OR an explicit human-ack override signed by two owners. I think we can make the deploy-bot refuse otherwise.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: recorded deployment 2024-06-10 14:12 UTC job=ci/4012 rollout=8 auto_rollback=false -> flagged.

maya: Good. Let's standardize the rollback rule format. Suggestion (pseudo):

```
rollback_rules:
  - name: latency-tail-p99
    metric: service.p99_ms
    condition: ">= 250"
    window: "3m"
    action: rollback
  - name: error-rate
    metric: service.error_rate
    condition: ">= 0.02"
    window: "5m"
    action: rollback
```

rick: Implementation note: controller should attach metadata (incident link, trigger metric, snapshot of rollout percent) when flipping. That makes audits easier.

ortega: Also recommend a "post-rollout smoke" job that runs for N minutes against the variant and verifies a small but representative request set. If smoke fails, it should trigger the same rollback path.

nina: I'll open a PR to add the preflight check into deploy-bot: https://git.redwood.example/p/deploy-bot/pull/321. It will enforce the two-owner override and require auto_rollback flag for most services.

maya: OK capture action items and deadlines:
- rick: rollback controller POC -> +5 business days -> 1888120000
- nina: deploy-bot preflight + owners override -> +2 business days -> 1887800000
- ortega: RFC for default percents & per-service caps -> EOD Thu -> 1887720000
- ops: create canary-smoke job template and add to pipeline -> +3 business days -> 1887950000

maya: Please reply with :white_check_mark: when done and paste links to PRs/tickets here. I'll update the postmortem ticket (INC-2024-189) with owners + timeline.

rick: :white_check_mark: created INC-2024-190 for the controller POC and added a brief design.

nina: :white_check_mark: PR opened and tests added. marking staging as blocked until config is present.

ortega: RFC draft up at https://docs.redwood.example/rfcs/rollout-safety. Will iterate.

ops-bot: ops-bot: created canary-smoke job template in sandbox (job id: smoke-2024-77).

maya: Thanks all. We'll regroup in 3 days for a status check. If anything stalls, ping @eng-platform and we'll reallocate. :clipboard:
